post.description: Authenticates a local account and issues a user session cookie. A successful sign-in also sets an HttpOnly known-device cookie; later attempts for that email from the same browser spend the browser's own budget instead of the email's. The cookie never authenticates. An email with a NUL character or an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate is refused with 400 INVALID_REQUEST and spends budget like a rejected password; the password is not checked for either.

cleanup.description: Saved cleanup status for this Agent revision, separate from its deployment result. `null` means no cleanup requirement was recorded. `succeeded` confirms that cleanup is complete.

cause.description: Why the startup model check failed, classified by the runtime.

detail.description: A fixed token for the kind, such as exit-1, signal-SIGKILL, error-ENOBUFS, format, rate_limit, billing, no_model, turn-failed, tool-event, no-reply, json or shape. A Codex token ends -attempt2, such as rate_limit-attempt2, when a retried check failed again. Never native output.

kind.description: PROCESS_EXIT: the check process exited nonzero, was killed or could not run. PROBE_STATUS: the check ran and reported the model unusable. INVALID_OUTPUT: its output was not the expected JSON. WRAPPER_ERROR: the runtime wrapper could not prepare or read the check.

error.description: `null` unless deployment failed. A failure contains `code`, a fixed safe message, and optional data with known fields. `CONVERGENCE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` can include `data.timeoutMs` and `data.runtimeFailure` with startup failure details. A component, check, or code unknown to the runtime is shown as `UNRECOGNIZED`. `RUNTIME_MODEL_PROBE_FAILED` can include `data.runtimeFailure` with the cause of the failed startup model check. The response never includes native error text.

lastAttempt.description: Latest reconciliation result bound to this exact deployment work item. Null means no bound result is available, not proof that work never ran. Codes and messages are allowlisted; provider text is not exposed.

nextAttemptAt.description: Earliest time queued work is eligible to run, not a promised start time. Null while claimed.

progress.description: Pending deployment progress. Null for terminal outcomes. A last attempt describes a recorded result, not current runtime health.

warnings.description: Warnings recorded from this deployment startup. Plugin install and connector-auth warnings mean the deployment succeeded after the runtime disabled the affected admitted plugin for that startup.

pluginId.description: The admitted Agent plugin selection key.
